evidence: Six-process environment contrast: frozen order produced 3 body-pose/image digests; preseed produced1, while dynamic state stayed identical. No policy outcomes were measured.
protocol_version: controlled_environment_seed_v1, new diagnostic protocol not historical V3 parity
environment_seed: Python and NumPy12351 immediately before suite/environment construction, after policy/processor loading; same seed for both checkpoints and every init
policy_seed: Keep frozen V3 NumPy/Torch/CUDA seeding after init restoration and wait; paired effective12345+2i, fixedinit3 effective12351. Explicit Python seed at environment construction is a documented protocol change.

validity: Assert identical initial environment/model/image digests across matched checkpoints and fixedinit3 repeats. Compare preprocessed inputs explicitly; differing processor/model hashes are tracked checkpoint differences, not assumed identical. Any protocol/capture/runtime error stops and preserves scene.
analysis: Per-model20paired successes and fixedinit3 five outcomes; all paired transitions, exact McNemar and uncertainty. Stability threshold unchanged>=11/20 and5/5. A pass on previously used inits is not unused-init generalization.

limits: Early seed is an evaluation-control change, not improved learning or exact historical reproduction; environmental geometry mediation is supported but not uniquely proven. All old V3 failures and counts stay unchanged.
